intro: Brie Hollingsworth Krebs and Elle Harting are sisters. together they grew up in the Arizona desert, laughing and giggling at wild things and fantastical dreams.
together_alt: Brie Hollingsworth Krebs and Elle Harting
together_caption: Brie and Elle - sisters, and the two halves of this book.

people.name: Brie Hollingsworth Krebs
people.bio: mom and fitness guru, writing in Charlotte, NC. living vicariously through her little kid's silliness.

people.name: Elle Harting
people.bio: mom and product manager, doodling in Poulsbo, WA. Elle's kid is living vicariously through mom's silliness.

mission_body: there is more coming, and we read wherever they will have us. come find us at a bookshop or a library near you.
